salvaged_prereveal_object.salvage_basis: The object was committed directly on top of the bootstrap head before any corpus or retrieval candidate pool was authored or inspected.

predecessor_objects_explicitly_invalid_f: GOLD.json or any sealed-gold artifact from the blocked execution
any draft or receipt derived from the locally reproduced BM25 fallback
successor_requires_fresh: all exact authoritative depth-10 candidate pools

properties: checks out the exact pinned Evidence Bundler commit in an isolated directory
installs and imports that exact package
uses the pinned V1 build_package implementation with the exact 10/3 config identity
runs each lane twice and requires byte-identical native package output
requires exactly 10 unique candidates and candidate_depth_hit for every lane
does not open or execute selector code

pre_reveal_denylist: PR #82 body, comments, diff, checks, artifacts, or branch narrative
normal CAL Pipeline conversation history or saved summaries about selector behavior
the blocked predecessor's source fixtures, candidate pools, gold, eligibility, evaluator, or fallback outputs
any frozen target source bytes before a valid successor READY_FOR_REVEAL receipt
nonclaims: The predecessor BLOCKED_APPARATUS run is not a selector result.
